=== usage
exit 2
Second-stage guard: a project's session may not open a session for another project (across projects: letters only).

Platform event open_session_attempt (bin/hub-event calls decide). The input is a neutral target, which the runtime's
binding translates from the native arguments (Claude Code: the Desktop start_session tool; see runtime_claude.parse_event):
  cwd        → not under this session's own project (the main checkout or one of its worktrees): denied
  elsewhere  → another repository, another machine, a preset that does not say where: denied
If neither is given, it is the same project and is allowed. A denial returns the reason (telling it to send a letter),
which the binding turns into the native "deny". Projects never onboarded (e.g. the platform itself) are not guarded;
when this script itself fails it allows (a broken guard must not block normal work).
`guard.py pre-tool` is the old entry point; projects that have not switched to the new settings still call it.


=== other cwd
A proj session cannot open a session in <TMP>/other (that is not this project). To ask another project for something, send a letter: agenthub send --to <project> --type request --text "…"; or ask the owner to open a session in that project themselves.
=== repository
A proj session cannot open a session in another repository (o/r). To ask another project for something, send a letter: agenthub send --to <project> --type request --text "…"; or ask the owner to open a session in that project themselves.
=== machine
A proj session cannot open a session on another machine. To ask another project for something, send a letter: agenthub send --to <project> --type request --text "…"; or ask the owner to open a session in that project themselves.
=== unknown place
When a proj session opens a session with a preset, there is no way to tell whether it is the same project; for the same project, give no preset or cwd. To ask another project for something, send a letter: agenthub send --to <project> --type request --text "…"; or ask the owner to open a session in that project themselves.
=== same project
None
